about: The balance gate's bands (tools/balance-check.mjs). Each band records what the game IS, with room for an 80-seed sample - measured on 120 seeds in docs/lab/damage-model-2026-09-18.md. A band is moved in the PR that means to move the game, and its `why` says so. ALL OF THEM MOVED on 2026-09-18 (D37): the chassis costs three times what it did and its upgrades six tenths, every body is plated from wave 6, energy goes through armour, resistances are wide, and Standard and Grim were re-fitted behind that.

bands.why: A player who knows nothing - one plain Bolt by the entry, then nothing - holds Calm's wave 5. The stranger test plays Calm to wave 5 unaided. Unmoved by D37 on purpose: plating begins at wave 6. Measured 99% of 120.
...and then loses, having seen the game. Measured 1% of 120.
The base world's mixed line, bought depth first and going on, wins Calm. Measured 100% of 120.

D37: plain Bolts at the choke, never upgraded, as many as Scrap allows, do NOT win Standard. They won it 99% until 2026-09-18. Measured 3% of 120. If this band goes red, width is winning again - look at chassis prices and plating before anything else.
The same on Grim: 84% until 2026-09-18, 0% of 120 after.
Three plain Bolts by the entry and nothing more do not win Standard. Measured 0% of 120.

The mixed line wins Standard most of the time - fitted to the UPPER end of 85-95% on purpose, because the lab's player buys the instant it can afford and places by arithmetic, and a person does neither. Measured 93% of 120 at x1.12.

L5, met for the first time: Grim is LOST by the base world. Measured 11% of 120 at x1.17 (18% holding six commons). It was 91-97% until 2026-09-18, and no curve could move it while width was unbounded.
...and WON by the tree: the same line with the whole workshop bought and six relics held at the epic band. Measured 99% of 120. A ceiling - the relics are held from wave 1.

NOT a player: six towers laid chassis first, then upgraded, then nothing - played to wave 40. It dies mid-run, so its mean death wave moves with the smallest change to a curve, a price or a road, where the win rates above sit near 0% or 100% and do not. Measured 13.68 over 80 (25.20 before D37); half a wave either side.
The same thermometer on Grim. Measured 10.82 over 80 (21.85 before D37). Proven in PR #360: a nudge of x0.01 to Grim's growth moves it most of a wave.
